answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared lagoon of bonded deposits before earning rewards. A reputation vine then links each agent to peers who vouched for it, so a fake identity starts with no history and no backers. Honest agents cluster around a verified oasis of long-lived, high-stake identities, while a Sybil farm must fund every fake separately and forfeit its stake when caught, so mass fakery costs more than it can ever earn.
